visualReview.notes: All13 final portable views inspected. Three bridge vaults and three different gate passages remain open. Rounded gate ends and stone roof close correctly; upper windows have actual cut openings and recessed dark inserts. The three western machicolation arches now meet their stepped corbels; window is above the relieving arch.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All13 final shared surface frames inspected. Mixed red/buff sandstone, individual stone slate courses, recessed timber ceiling and ironwork render with the shared library. Current load and unload assertions pass.

geographicReview.notes: Exact bridge perimeter and separate gate footprint reviewed with +X northeast toward Monmouth. Decorated face points southwest and plain face northeast. Flat map review passes; real riverbed/bank fit has not yet been verified.

fidelityReview.notes: 254,408-triangle original exterior based on Cadw2218 and dated primary photos. Includes ribbed medieval vaults inside later segmental widening, actual passages with pointed and Caernarvon heads, northwest garderobe, west machicolations, roof of two half cones and central ridge, eaves corbels/gutter, recessed upper openings and hand-worked rubble relief. Exact arch stations, elevations, individual stones and roof details are reconstructed; no survey/scan precision or upper-room interior is asserted.
